notes: V7.1.10: per-bot auto-schedule. The single 'Auto-trade on US market schedule' checkbox is replaced by a row of per-bot checkboxes in Tools → AUTOMATION — tick only the bots you want APEX to auto-start at market open and auto-stop at the close. Existing users with the legacy global flag are migrated automatically. Silenced bots are excluded from the row until you un-silence them. Next on the roadmap: bots running 24/7 on the Oracle server with cloud-side scheduling, so laptops can be off.
